themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social benefits, housing, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence in Spain, Italy, Poland, Argentina, and France, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, La Libertad Avanza, and Rassemblement National leading the charge. The framing often ties these policies to broader anti-immigration rhetoric and critiques of globalist influences.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes redirecting funds from ecologists to young farmers and advocates for 'national priority' in housing and social benefits, explicitly rejecting multiculturalism.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports policies that prioritize Italian citizens in welfare and employment, aligning with nationalist rhetoric against EU migration policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Advocates for policies favoring Polish citizens in healthcare and social benefits, often framing immigration as a threat to national identity.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Promotes deregulation and privatization while emphasizing national sovereignty over globalist economic policies, indirectly supporting 'national priority' in resource allocation.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Champions policies that prioritize French citizens in welfare, housing, and employment, with a strong anti-immigration stance.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is facing a constitutional crisis as legal experts and civil society groups argue that the party violates Germany's democratic principles. This theme has dominated German media, with intense coverage of potential bans, internal divisions, and extremist rhetoric. The debate has also resonated in broader European discourse, particularly in relation to the AfD's ties to historical fascism and its impact on democratic institutions.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Faces potential constitutional ban due to extremist rhetoric and policies, with legal experts citing violations of democratic principles and human dignity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Monitors AfD's crisis as a cautionary tale, while distancing itself from extremist labels despite similar nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticized for financial ties to Hungary's far-right government, drawing parallels to AfD's extremist associations.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Observes AfD's crisis amid its own nationalist policies, balancing between European alliances and domestic far-right support.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with Trump publicly criticizing Meloni for her stance on NATO and military engagements. This theme has seen strong convergence in Italy and the U.S., with spillover effects in France and Spain, where far-right leaders are navigating their own relationships with Trump. The fallout highlights broader tensions between nationalist leaders and transatlantic alliances.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.note: Monitors the fallout as a cautionary example, balancing nationalist policies with transatlantic alliances.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Meloni's handling of the crisis, advocating for stronger alignment with Trump's nationalist agenda.

themes.title: Judicial and corruption scandals in far-right governments
themes.blurb: Corruption scandals and judicial investigations are plaguing far-right governments and parties across multiple countries, including Argentina, Spain, Poland, and Hungary. These scandals often involve allegations of misuse of public funds, illicit enrichment, and political interference in judicial processes. The theme has seen strong convergence, with opposition parties and media amplifying these narratives to undermine far-right credibility.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Accused of financial irregularities, including diverting public funds to its foundation and failing to disclose loans from Hungary.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Faces corruption allegations in healthcare, including preferential treatment for party members at Warsaw's Southern Hospital.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Allegations of misuse of public funds in cultural grants, with investigations targeting former Fidesz officials.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are grappling with internal divisions, often centered around leadership disputes, ideological disagreements, and strategic misalignments. These divisions have weakened party cohesion and led to public infighting, particularly in Germany's AfD, Italy's Lega, Argentina's La Libertad Avanza, and Sweden's Sverigedemokraterna. The theme highlights the fragility of far-right unity despite shared nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts between factions led by Javier Milei, Patricia Bullrich, and Karina Milei, with public disputes over government strategy.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
